title: Seth Meyers on Elon Musk saying he’s not Maga: ‘Trump’s closest allies are scrambling to get away’
text:
Late-night hosts mocked Elon Musk’s claim that he is “not Maga” and Donald Trump’s cozy summit with Xi Jinping and his “friend” Vladimir Putin.
Seth Meyers
After a week of cascading outages and tech failures, “Americans are worried because everything is broken,” said Seth Meyers on Thursday’s Late Night. “But rather than fix it, the Trump team is scapegoating Democrats.”
Speaking on cable news, JD Vance claimed that Congress could fix things “with Democrats in Congress if they set aside the ridiculous obsession with men in women’s sports”.
The transportation secretary, Sean Duffy, tried a similar tactic, arguing that Democrats were too concerned with “what names we use” for a plane’s cockpit to pass funding for infrastructure. “Sorry, what the hell are you talking about?!” Meyers retorted. “I don’t remember Joe Biden making a big announcement about changing the name of cockpit – ‘and another thing, we’re renaming the landing strip. From now on it’s called a gender neutral pubic area.’”
“Voters hate this,” Meyers noted. “That’s why Republicans got crushed in the midterms. Just this week, Democrats won another Senate seat in Alaska and now Trump’s closest allies are scrambling to get away from him as fast as they can.”
On Thursday, Trump’s former friend and associate Elon Musk distanced himself from the president, saying in an interview that the more than $445m he spent on Republican candidates in the midterm elections was “pretty foolish” and that he was “not Maga”.
“I’m sorry, you’re not Maga? But you said this,” Meyers responded before a clip of Musk at a Trump rally from October 2024, in which he sported a black Maga hat and claimed: “I’m not just Maga, I’m dark, gothic Maga.”
“Sounds like you’re Maga, man!” Meyers laughed.
“That would be like you saying, ‘I like to hew my way through wood with an old-fashioned handsaw’ when we all heard you say this,” he added with the infamous clip of Musk wielding a chainsaw on stage at the 2025 CPAC conference.
Meyers continued: “You spent nearly half a billion on Maga candidates, you spoke at the inauguration, you campaigned with Trump and on top of all that, you were at the White House so often you were basically their Kramer. You even sat in the driveway with Trump while he marveled at all the screens in your stupid car.”
Musk’s defection, however unconvincing, is yet more evidence that “the Trump presidency is a failure”, Meyers concluded, “and now everyone involved is racing for the exits”.
Jimmy Kimmel
On Jimmy Kimmel Live!, the host recapped Trump’s chummy summit with the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, and the Russian leader, Vladimir Putin, in China. “For all the diabolical villainy they had hired in one room, I have to say the atmosphere was pretty relaxed,” Kimmel noted.
“Trump really likes being a part of this trio. There were a lot of photo ops. They even joined arms for a little mall walk together,” he added before a clip of the three leaders walking together down a hallway. “There he is, our Darth Tax Evader, and the emperors who gave him his imperial marching orders.”
Speaking to reporters afterwards, Trump rated his meeting with Putin a 12 out of 10, and Putin said the meeting went better than anyone expected. “How is that possible?” Kimmel fumed. “At this point, what more could Trump possibly give him? Alaska?
“It’s so embarrassing watching him interact with these guys,” he continued. “Russia is our enemy. They don’t like us. They are bombing our allies going on now for almost five years. And look at how he greets him!”
Kimmel then played the clip of Trump greeting “my friend” with a close handshake and “nice to see you”.
“How is that OK with anyone?!” he marveled. “Vladimir Putin is a terrible person. He’s a brutal dictator. He is a murderer. He kills people. He poisons them, he has them shoved out of windows. But I guess that’s all OK because ‘he’s my friend.’
“My God, I mean, even if you voted for this guy, you have to admit he has the worst taste in friends,” he concluded next to a photo of Trump with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
